deniedPaths.reason: Upstream channel artwork has no separate image grant; the first release excludes the channel entries and their assets (19/12 §2, L2).
An AionUi product mark: Apache-2.0 §6 grants no trademark right, so the product supplies its own mark (19/12 §2).
AionUi brand images and provider logos the first release does not distribute (19/12 §2).
Upstream PWA icons and manifest carry AionUi branding and are replaced by product-owned assets (19/12 §2).
The file-icon JSON has no recorded upstream commit or licence; only admitted generic icons may ship (19/12 §3).
Package metadata says MIT while the icon set itself states CC BY-SA 4.0 and per-brand terms; the conflict is unresolved (19/12 §3).
Pet assets are outside the shipped feature set and are not copied (19/12 §2).
The pet HTML entrypoints are removed from the renderer config (19/12 §2).
KaTeX ships SIL OFL fonts whose source chain is unclosed, so formulas stay source-only instead of shipping unaccounted fonts (19/12 §4, 19 §5).
Sentry CLI is FSL-1.1-MIT build tooling and never product content (19/12 §4).
LGPL native imaging packages are not distributed with the product (19/12 §4).
sharp and its native dependencies stay build/back-end only (19/12 §4).
Its default configuration fetches from a CDN, which an offline product cannot use (19/12 §4).

fontDecision.reason: KaTeX carries SIL OFL 1.1 fonts whose source chain and reserved-font-name handling are unclosed (19/12 §4), so formulas render as their source text and no font ships.
fontDecision.gate: No font file may enter the product under this decision; admitting one requires closing its licence chain (source, sha256, copyright, offline OFL text) and changing this decision together with the audit rule.
